Per policy, an order for a customer over their credit limit is held until the owner decides, so I applied the hold. CU-0019 is not one of the five largest customers by revenue (top 5 are CU-0007, CU-0005, CU-0004, CU-0003, CU-0002; CU-0019 ranks well below at ~$19.6k lifetime revenue vs. six-figure totals for the top 5), so this hold does not require owner pre-approval under the top-5 rule. I did not chase payment or take other action beyond the hold since that wasn't requested; happy to send overdue-payment reminders on the two open invoices if wanted (both are within the 90-day reminder window).
